items.question: Which four animal-faced female attendants are to be worshipped in the sixteen-petaled diagram?
premises: The context prescribes worship in the sixteen-petaled diagram.
Four distinct animal-faced female figures are named in sequence.
Their names specify elephant, lion, vulture, and crow features.
items.inference: The elephant-faced, lion-faced, vulture-faced, and crow-beaked female attendants are included among the deities to be worshipped in that locus.
items.plain_english: One should worship the elephant-faced one, the lion-faced one, the vulture-faced one, and the crow-beaked one.
